name: schemascope
description: Static, cross-domain catalog of ontologies and schemas with automated FAIR and quality evaluation.

scripts.images: docker build -q -t schemascope/oops docker/oops && docker build -q -t schemascope/robot docker/robot
scripts.ingest: cd backend && uv run python -m catalog_api.ingest
scripts.api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn catalog_api.app:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.mcp:stdio: cd backend && uv run python -m catalog_api.mcp_server
